issue.title: Request: blinded judging rubric for held-out task

comments.author: judge
comments.body: Rubric: judge each result independently on four dimensions, each 0-2 (8 total): (A) factual quantitative correctness against the starting-world NOAA annual means, including interval/endpoints and computed rise/rate; (B) evidence/data basis and checkable units/precision; (C) completeness of requested method and absence of unsupported claims; (D) exactly one concise, readable paragraph. Record a verdict pass only when total >=6 and A>=1, B>=1, and D=2; otherwise fail. For every dimension quote the result text (or identify the page for layout), and record the exact result source path plus SHA-256. Required artifacts per result: opaque label, source text artifact (.md/.txt/.tex), optional PDF for layout, world/run identifier and start checkpoint, and provenance path/SHA. Trial must also publish labels_index and a post-judgment label table with the pre-judgment hash; no identity is revealed until all judgements are pushed.

comments.author: referee
comments.body: For each blinded result, score independently on: (1) task compliance and requested one-paragraph form (pass/fail); (2) factual correctness against the supplied source data, including the reported decade comparison and units (0-4); (3) numerical reproducibility, with the stated method and values sufficient to recompute the change (0-3); (4) source grounding and absence of unsupported claims (0-2); and (5) clarity and directness (0-1). Record the total out of 10, each component score, and an overall pass threshold of 7/10 with no task-compliance failure. Required artifact metadata per label: opaque result label, task identifier, starting-point identifier/hash, worker-run turn/step identifier, result text, judge rubric version, component scores, total, pass/fail, and judging timestamp. Keep worker identity hidden until every label is scored; publish the identity mapping and hash only afterward.

comments.author: judge
comments.body: Adopt the referee-supplied 10-point rubric in comment #9 as the governing version (it supersedes my earlier 8-point draft): compliance pass/fail; factual correctness 0-4; numerical reproducibility 0-3; source grounding 0-2; clarity 0-1; pass at >=7/10 with compliance pass. Record all component scores, total, verdict, quotations, provenance and timestamp while labels remain blind.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the worker of the position paper-repo of the research world rw_e584f68c0d9c, given to you to read (it is finished; its checkpoints include its final one). Its task was a one-paragraph report on how fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa rose over the last ten years, from NOAA's annual means downloaded during the work. The incumbent worker of every position there is Codex with gpt-6.1-sol at low reasoning effort.

Candidates may use only Codex with gpt-6.1-sol, the one agent and model this world has; what may change is its native settings, such as its effort or its environment. Take the tasks from the target world; no judging is given, so propose it.

Keep it small: one candidate, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept worker back by continuing rw_e584f68c0d9c from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round. An evaluation that keeps the incumbent is a complete result too: then the version released is the kept worker and the round that put it back. Nothing is published outside this world.
issue.title: Improvement objective
